items.item: Percentiles, not the mean, are the right way to state a latency-shaped SLI, because response-time data is skewed and the mean hides the worst case that users actually feel.

A critical user journey, not an individual component, is the recommended unit to define an SLO around — a practiced, more disciplined version of the five-questions habit this topic teaches from scratch.
